verdicts.argument: The bid does not provide any evidence that the disposal of the 150 m³ of excavated material is covered by another position or a contractual clause; therefore the claim remains unrefuted.
No text in the bid documents indicates that the calculation error is covered by a neighboring position or a correction clause; the discrepancy stands.
The bid lacks any explicit definition of the excavation depth or soil class in the provided texts, so the uncertainty is not mitigated by the documents.
The long text does not specify a removal thickness or soil class, and no other position in the documents compensates for this omission.
There is no separate position for site preparation, and the bid does not reference any clause that would implicitly cover it; the issue remains unresolved.
The bid’s description of the pipe supply is incomplete, and no other position or clause in the documents clarifies the missing specifications.
The bid lists only the supply of the pipe; installation and backfilling are not mentioned elsewhere, so the claim is not rebutted.
The file is truncated, and the bid does not provide any additional evidence that the missing positions or totals are covered elsewhere.
The invalid number format is not corrected by any other text in the bid, so the value remains unreadable and the claim stands.
